howCharmWorks: Every order reserves $0.50 + 1% (cap $5) for urgent rescue care, and Pawket Passes help that kindness travel from one pet family to the next.

storyPlaceholder.title: Protected memorial origin
storyPlaceholder.body: CHARM honors the love behind Pet Pawket while public rescue stories, medical updates, and memorial submissions stay consent-aware and carefully reviewed.

charmEditions: CHARM Editions reserve a portion of each pack for rescue care.
Limited drops help fund urgent cases and memorial support.
